source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: **[Guardians of the Machine](vsdata:ability/grey-knights.brotherhood-techmarine.guardians-of-the-machine)** lets this unit use **[Heroic Intervention](vsdata:core-rule/heroic-intervention)** for 1 CP less when a charging enemy finishes its [Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move) engaged with a friendly **GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE** no farther than 6″ from this unit. The Stratagem targets this unit. Other units can use **Heroic Intervention** earlier or later in the same phase.

typedMechanics.trigger: enemy charge ends engaged with nearby friendly Grey Knights Vehicle
typedMechanics.sharedUseRestriction: other-unit use allowed before and after in same phase
